beats.text: In the late 1970s, geophysicists Glen Penfield and Antonio Camargo discovered a mysterious anomaly while working for Petróleos Mexicanos (Pemex) as part of an airborne magnetic survey of the Gulf of Mexico north of the Yucatán Peninsula.
beats.say: in the late one nine seven zero s geophysicists glen penfield and antonio camargo discovered a mysterious anomaly while working for petróleos mexicanos pemex as part of an airborne magnetic survey of the gulf of mexico north of the yucatán peninsula

beats.text: They noted a shallow 'bullseye' 180 km in diameter, suggesting an impact feature. Despite their findings, Pemex rejected the crater theory, attributing the feature to volcanic activity.
beats.say: they noted a shallow bullseye one hundred eighty kilometers in diameter suggesting an impact feature despite their findings pemex rejected the crater theory attributing the feature to volcanic activity

beats.text: In 1990, Penfield obtained samples from Pemex wells, which showed shock-metamorphic materials, confirming the impact theory.
beats.say: in nineteen nine zero penfield obtained samples from pemex wells which showed shock metamorphic materials confirming the impact theory

beats.text: The crater, named Chicxulub, was confirmed to be the site of the asteroid impact that triggered the mass extinction event 66 million years ago.
beats.say: the crater named chicxulub was confirmed to be the site of the asteroid impact that triggered the mass extinction event sixty six million years ago

beats.text: Scientists now believe this asteroid impact was the primary cause of the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event, leading to the extinction of 75% of plant and animal species, including all non-avian dinosaurs.
beats.say: scientists now believe this asteroid impact was the primary cause of the cretaceous paleogene extinction event leading to the extinction of seventy five percent of plant and animal species including all non avian dinosaurs

facts.claim: The crater was discovered in the late 1970s by geophysicists Glen Penfield and Antonio Camargo.
facts.quote: In the late 1970s, geophysicists Glen Penfield and Antonio Camargo were working for the Mexican state-owned oil company Petróleos Mexicanos (Pemex) as part of an airborne magnetic survey of the Gulf of Mexico north of the Yucatán Peninsula.

facts.claim: The crater was named after the nearby town of Chicxulub Pueblo.
facts.quote: The crater was named for the nearby town of Chicxulub Pueblo.

facts.claim: The impact occurred around 66 million years ago, coinciding with the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event.
facts.quote: A 2013 study published in Science estimated the age of the impact as 66,043,000 ± 11,000 years ago (± 43,000 years ago considering systematic error), based on multiple lines of evidence, including argon–argon dating of tektites from Haiti and bentonite horizons overlying the impact horizon in northeastern Montana.
